hazards.control: Hands clear of actuators, handwheels, and lifting gear.

name: Suction (clean side) pump
function: The centrifugal pump that draws water from the tanks or hydration unit into the tub.

tabs.overview: Sized above the maximum slurry rate so the tub never starves; suction hoses from the tanks are large bore.
tabs.safety: Suction hose collapse and seal leaks.
tabs.evidence: Public equipment overviews (S22), public simultaneous-frac articles (S17, S18, S19), field practice (S9). Rates and horsepower are typical values, not a design basis.
